issue.title: When no "selected" queries are present, term panel bypasses filters defined

repository.name: kibana
repository.description: Your window into all of your data

issue.body:
Setup:
1.  Create a term panel configured to use "Selected" queries
2.  Create 1 or 2 queries that can be selected from the term panel.
3.  Create a filter that is active

Test 1:
If one or more queries are selected within the term panel, everything works fine, it narrows down the resultset using the queries selected and also honor the filter defined.

Test 2:

Configure the term panel to "all" queries.  You will see that the terms returned are filtered by the active filter only.

Test 3:

Configure the term panel back to "selected" queries.  However, do not select any queries (i.e. all available queries unselected).  You will see that instead of returning a dataset that matches Test 2 above, it returns a dataset that is equivalent to no queries or filters applied (i.e. returns the entire corpus).  Expectation is for this test case is for the terms panel to honor the active filter and not return all data.

body: An empty `bool` filter or query should be treated as a `match_all`.
